```{r}
library("wooldridge")
```

### Example 10.1
```{r}
data("phillips")

model_10_1 <- lm(inf ~ unem, data = phillips)
summary(model_10_1)
```

### Example 10.2
```{r}
data("intdef")

model_10_2 <- lm(i3 ~ inf + def, data = intdef)
summary(model_10_2)
```

### Example 10.3
```{r}
data("prminwge")

model_10_3 <- lm(lprepop ~ lmincov + lusgnp, data = prminwge)
summary(model_10_3)
```

### Example 10.4
```{r}
data("fertil3")

model_10_4_1 <- lm(gfr ~ pe + ww2 + pill, data = fertil3)
summary(model_10_4_1)
```

```{r}
model_10_4_2 <- lm(gfr ~ pe + pe_1 + pe_2 + ww2 + pill, data = fertil3)
summary(model_10_4_2)
```

```{r}
# Joint significance of pe values
model_10_4_2_res <- lm(gfr ~ ww2 + pill,
                       data = fertil3,
                       subset = (is.na(pe_2) == FALSE))
anova(model_10_4_2, model_10_4_2_res)
```

```{r}
# Joint significance of lagged pe values
model_10_4_2_res2 <- lm(gfr ~ pe + ww2 + pill,
                        data = fertil3,
                        subset = (is.na(pe_2) == FALSE))
anova(model_10_4_2, model_10_4_2_res2)
```

```{r}
# Standard error of the long run propensity
model_10_4_lrp <- lm(gfr ~ pe + I(pe_1 - pe) + I(pe_2 - pe_1) + ww2 + pill,
                     data = fertil3)
summary(model_10_4_lrp)
```

### Example 10.5
```{r}
data("barium")

model_10_5 <- lm(lchnimp ~ lchempi + lgas + lrtwex + befile6 + affile6 + afdec6,
                 data = barium)
summary(model_10_5)
```

### Example 10.6
```{r}
data("fair")

model_10_6 <- lm(demvote ~ partyWH + incum + I(partyWH * gnews) +
                   I(partyWH * inf),
                 data = fair)
summary(model_10_6)
```

Slightly different results since the book uses 20 observations to 1992. But the results are the same when we drop the last observation.

```{r}
model_10_6 <- lm(demvote ~ partyWH + incum + I(partyWH * gnews) +
                   I(partyWH * inf),
                 data = fair,
                 subset = (year != 1996))
summary(model_10_6)
```

### Example 10.7
```{r}
data("hseinv")

model_10_7_1 <- lm(linvpc ~ lprice, data = hseinv)
summary(model_10_7_1)
```

Add a time trend
```{r}
model_10_7_2 <- lm(linvpc ~ lprice + t, data = hseinv)
summary(model_10_7_2)
```

### Example 10.8
```{r}
data("fertil3")

model_10_8_1 <- lm(gfr ~ pe + ww2 + pill + t, data = fertil3)
summary(model_10_8_1)
```

```{r}
model_10_8_2 <- lm(gfr ~ pe + ww2 + pill + t + tsq, data = fertil3)
summary(model_10_8_2)
```

### Example 10.9
```{r}
data("prminwge")

model_10_9 <- lm(lprepop ~ lmincov + lusgnp + t, data = prminwge)
summary(model_10_9)
```

```{r}
# Obtain results by detrending
lprepop_detrend <- lm(lprepop ~ t, data = prminwge)[["residuals"]]
lmincov_detrend <- lm(lmincov ~ t, data = prminwge)[["residuals"]]
lusgnp_detrend <- lm(lusgnp ~ t, data = prminwge)[["residuals"]]

summary(lm(lprepop_detrend ~ lmincov_detrend + lusgnp_detrend - 1))
```

### Example 10.10
```{r}
data("hseinv")

dtr_linvpc <- lm(linvpc ~ t, data = hseinv)[["residuals"]]
summary(lm(dtr_linvpc ~ lprice + t, data = hseinv))
```

### Example 10.11
```{r}
data("barium")

model_10_11 <- lm(lchnimp ~ lchempi + lgas + lrtwex + befile6 + affile6 +
                    afdec6 + feb + mar + apr + may + jun + jul + aug + sep +
                    oct + nov + dec,
                  data = barium)
model_10_11_res <- lm(lchnimp ~ lchempi + lgas + lrtwex + befile6 + affile6 +
                        afdec6,
                      data = barium)

anova(model_10_11, model_10_11_res)
```
